answer: An agent economy can anchor standing to external-registry anchoring. Each identity must register a distinct business with a registrar, survive a 30-day notice period, and receive a code at a separate real address, like one yarrow in its own plot, not a cloned orchard row. Like a sonnet, each filing follows a fixed form yet must carry original details. Filings on one funding trail are limited to one per month with the fee doubling each time, so they cannot be bulk-bought or run in parallel. Each extra fake costs another doubled outside fee, another real address, and another notice month.
